prompt:
Repair this single scene from input1. FIRST widen the framing: the entire square slab, its lowest front corner and both full planar cut faces must sit comfortably inside the image with blank margins. Use one high-angle PARALLEL ORTHOGRAPHIC projection. Ground, floor bands and all level roofs use identical parallel screen-axis directions at every height. Flat square slab, identical vertical thickness at every corner, no curvature, no perspective enlargement. Retain broad soil layers and functional sub-ground utilities.

Keep two rear blocking boundaries and exactly two functional exits, one on each rear direction. DELETE the railings visible behind BOTH exits and replace the space behind them with clearly continuous walkable lanes; these exits must not end at balconies. Keep central street and both approaches free. All footings, structural supports, connections and closed human entry doors remain readable and grounded. Buildings share world X/Y axes; rounded cladding is coherent, not arbitrary building rotation. No exposed interiors or tall front barriers.

Preserve A as FOUR floors: narrower1, wider2 with projecting side wing and deep window/balcony, narrower3 consisting of substantial nonresidential retro machinery inside structural frames, wider4 with rounded projecting end window. Make the third-floor entire platform narrower than fourth, and the first-floor core narrower than second. Preserve mechanical volume, maintenance recesses, load-bearing supports and meaningful facade depth.

Preserve B as TWO floors: lower floor itself is bulky rounded retro machinery with a deep service slot, support frame and integrated human door; upper inhabited volume is larger and shifted sideways, with a clearly exposed supported overhang, curved end, recessed window and side deck. Keep each roof40–80% occupied by supported functional systems with empty roof area, not an extra floor. Compact game-scale planned enclosure about6.5m, no dimensional annotations.

Keep exactly two parked cars, one pickup with an open cargo bed and one passenger car; the red fire hydrant; large dumpster with nearby old refrigerator, washing machine, bags and loose paper; wall posters and separate graffiti. Preserve two real jagged asphalt breaks with visible missing pavement/substrate and sparse street litter. Dry matte roadway and LARGE geometric sidewalk tiles. No people, neon, glowing signs, green CRT or wet ground.

Repaint the finish as calm hand-painted game concept art. Use input5 for broad flat directional pigment swipes on INTACT walls, metal shells, vehicle paint, paving and asphalt. Each exposed large face gets a few wide closely related color strokes with generous quiet areas. Brushwork is separate from sparse local chipping/repair patches. REMOVE fine noise, speckles, repeated micro-scratches, all-over distressed paint, tiny mosaics, thin wavy marks and glass-like distortion. Retain readable deep architecture, physical thickness and materials through large simple light/shadow planes. Warm daylight and cool skylight, coherent shadows.

Input4 is the requested M4 RETRO-FUTURISM: keep varied cream/sage/ochre rounded enamel equipment shells, stepped housings, a few legible analog dials, substantial knobs and useful connections. These are salvaged, repaired and repurposed advanced machines integrated into buildings, not pristine gadget decorations. Input3 supplies LDI-style broad clean architectural material/color/light depiction, excluding characters and world. Input2 supplies only square topology and two rear exit directions. Input1 supplies only this scene content, never its faulty camera, cropped base or deficient brushwork. Input5 supplies brush color treatment only, never its fantasy bridge, architecture or water. Ignore every reference camera. Preserve all successful large forms, depths, current-request objects and retro design while correcting the defects.
